topics.title: Falls and Injury
steps: Stop moving and check for pain, bleeding, or dizziness.
Keep the injured person still if a head, neck, or back injury is possible.
Clean small cuts with safe water if available.
Cover bleeding with clean cloth and apply steady pressure.
Request help if the person cannot walk safely.

topics.title: Bleeding
steps: Apply firm pressure using clean cloth or gauze.
Raise the injured area if it can be done without causing more pain.
Do not remove soaked cloth; add another layer over it.
Keep the person warm and still.
Use SOS or call emergency services for heavy bleeding.

topics.title: Sprain or Twisted Ankle
steps: Stop walking and rest.
Avoid placing weight on the injured ankle.
Apply a cold compress if available.
Use support or bandage if trained to do so.
Request help if unable to continue safely.

topics.title: Heat Exhaustion
steps: Move to shade and stop hiking.
Loosen tight clothing and cool the skin.
Sip water slowly if the person is alert.
Watch for confusion, fainting, or vomiting.
Request emergency help if symptoms worsen.

topics.title: Snake Bite
steps: Move away from the snake without trying to catch it.
Keep the bitten person still and calm.
Remove tight items near the bite area.
Do not cut, suck, or apply ice to the bite.
Call emergency services and share your location.

topics.title: Lost or Stranded
steps: Stop moving and stay on or near the trail if possible.
Check battery and enable low-power mode.
Use the app to pin your current location.
Signal with whistle, light, or bright clothing.
Use SOS if injured, unsafe, or unable to return.

topics.title: Severe Weather
steps: Move away from exposed ridges, tall isolated trees, and flood-prone areas.
Turn back if visibility or footing becomes unsafe.
Keep electronics dry and preserve battery.
Wait in a safer sheltered area if moving is dangerous.
Notify contacts if your return time will be delayed.
